name: Izushi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Izushi town emblem in green: a disc crossed by a stylised letter Z-like stroke.
history: Flag of the former town of Izushi in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 February 1958.

features.role: Izushi town emblem — a disc crossed by a stylised letter Z-like stroke
